Title: Data Scientist
Description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien.

Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica, la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos a un/a Data Scientist enfocado en forecasting de series temporales para el área de Finanzas con 2 años de experiencia en responsabilidades similares. Perfil con base técnica sólida - escribir buen código y manejarse con soltura en el desarrollo, aunque la productivización final se aborde en colaboración con Data Engineers.

Grado en Data Science, Informática, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Finanzas cuantitativas o afín (MS/PhD valorable).
Python sólido, con buenas prácticas de desarrollo (código limpio, testeado, versionado).
PySpark para procesamiento distribuido de datos a gran escala.
Experiencia demostrable en forecasting de series temporales (clásico y/o ML).
Aplicación de técnicas de ML sobre datasets grandes (clustering, clasificación, regresión, detección de anomalías).
SQL para acceso y transformación de datos.
Comprensión sólida de metodologías ágiles.
Inglés profesional.




Será un PLUS:

Dominio financiero (planificación, riesgo, FP&A, tesorería).
Tecnologías de bases de datos en cloud (p. ej. AWS) y despliegue en infraestructura cloud de datos/analítica.
Contenedores y pipelines/microservicios (Docker, Kubernetes).
Herramientas de dashboarding (Dash, Tableau).




¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener modelos de forecasting de series temporales (métodos estadísticos clásicos —ARIMA/SARIMA, suavizado exponencial, modelos de espacio de estados— y enfoques ML/probabilísticos) aplicados a problemáticas financieras.
Escribir código limpio, ordenado y bien documentado en Python, aplicando buenas prácticas (modularidad, pruebas, control de versiones) para que los modelos sean reproducibles y mantenibles.
Procesar y modelar datos a gran escala con PySpark, construyendo pipelines eficientes sobre datasets financieros voluminosos.
Crear modelos repetibles, interpretables, dinámicos y escalables, y colaborar con data engineers y leads de negocio en su integración en aplicaciones y herramientas.
Ingeniería de features combinando fuentes internas y externas para mejorar la precisión predictiva.
Apoyar la monitorización, mantenimiento y mejora de los modelos una vez en uso.
Comunicar el enfoque analítico (relevancia, trade-offs) a partners de negocio y traducir resultados a implicaciones financieras accionables.
Trabajar de forma iterativa e incremental en un equipo ágil cross-funcional, buscando mejorar velocidad y calidad sprint a sprint.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrada en las Personas, ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas.

Contrato indefinido y salario entre los 28.000 y 34.000 euros brutos/año de entrada, ajustado según tu experiencia (nuestro plan de carrera incluye 2 revisiones anuales). También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa.

También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas.

Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid, la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly!




Si te interesa, escríbenos por LinkedIn o envía tu CV a seleccion@maticapartners.com

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Applied Data Scientist who thrives at the intersection of AI, product thinking, and innovation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing Data Science & ML algorithms to solve complex, real-world business problems across the team.blue group. Responsibilities:


Break down multi-domain business problems with a strong focus on return on investment and impact metrics, and think through the appropriate technical methods from POC to production
Develop solutions and extract insight from data using data science and classical machine learning methods and generative AI (GenAI)
Take ownership of developing, implementing, and automating robust data science and ML models and pipelines, including feature generation, modeling, evaluation, retraining and deployment
Translate sophisticated analytical findings and model outcomes into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, demonstrably driving value and improvements in key business metrics
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver innovative Data Science/ML/AI solutions
Conduct research on the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments and apply them to improve our systems
Document processes, code, and findings for future reference and knowledge sharing



Required Skills:


8+ years hands-on industry experience solving data science and machine learning problems to address real-world business problems across multiple verticals
Expert programming skills in Python and SQL and with relevant Data Science & ML frameworks (Scikit-learn, Pandas, PyTorch, etc)
Ability to think through problems from fundamental principles and operate with a high degree of independence and autonomy while bringing clarity to under-specified problems
Deep understanding of statistical and ML algorithms, methodologies and approaches ranging from SVMs to deep learning & LLMs
Ability to own the end to end of the lifecycle of ML/AI projects from conception to containerization
History of hands-on ownership & implementer of projects that have been put in production and made an impact
Experience in applying statistical concepts (e.g. regressions, A/B tests, clustering, probability) to business problems
Strong problem-solving skills with excellent verbal & written communication and the ability to craft analysis into well-written and persuasive content
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams



Nice to have skills


Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, AI, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, or related fields.
Deep understanding of current DataOps & MLOps practices, deploying and monitoring models and ETL (extract, transform and load) pipelines
Experience with AI/ML R&D
Experience across startups and enterprise firms
Experience with distributed data tools (e.g. Spark, Dask, Apache Arrow), observability frameworks (OTel)

Title: Data Science Technical Lead
Description:
Overview

Your role will be to be part of growing team based in Barcelona, to create and support global digital developments for PepsiCo. As a Data Science Technical Lead, you will play a pivotal role in leveraging advanced analytics and machine learning to deliver impactful solutions across critical business topics such as Consumer Insights, Revenue Management, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Logistics.

You will be part of a collaborative interdisciplinary team around data, where you will be responsible of building deployable statistical/machine learning models, beginning from the discovery phase through to implementation. You’ll collaborate closely with process owners, product managers, and end-users to ensure your developments are aligned with business priorities and drive measurable outcomes.

You will be an internal ambassador of the team’s culture around data and analytics fostering a culture of innovation, analytics, and collaboration fostering a culture of innovation, analytics, collaboration, and being a data driven leader . You will provide stewardship to colleagues in the areas that you are a specialist or you are specializing contributing to the team’s growth and success in data and analytics.

Responsibilities


Contributing member in a digital project acting as tech lead for the project.
Act as a subject matter expert in one other digital project.
Be the lead contributor in innovation activities
Partner with product managers in taking DS requirements and assessing DS components in roadmaps.
Partner with data engineers to ensure data access for discovery and proper data is prepared for model consumption.
Lead ML engineers to industrialize solutions.
Contribute with work activities that involve Business teams, other IT services and as required.
Drive the use of the Platform toolset and to also focus on 'the art of the possible' demonstrations to the business as needed.
Communicate with business stakeholders in the process of service design, training and knowledge transfer.
Support large-scale experimentation and build data-driven models.
Set KPIs and metrics to evaluate analytics solution given a particular use case.
Refine requirements into modelling problems.
Influence product teams through data-based recommendations.
Research in state-of-the-art methodologies.
Create documentation for learnings and knowledge transfer.
Support in creation reusable packages or libraries.


Qualifications


5+ years working in a team to deliver production level analytic solutions. Fluent in git (version control). Understanding of Jenkins, Docker are a plus.
5+ years’ experience in ETL and/or data wrangling techniques. Fluent in SQL syntaxis.
3+ years’ experience in Statistical/ML techniques to solve supervised (regression, classification) and unsupervised problems. Experiences with Deep Learning are a plus.
3+ years’ experience in developing business problem related statistical/ML modeling with industry tools with primary focus on Python or Scala development.
Business storytelling and communicating data insights in business consumable format. Fluent in one Visualization tool.
Strong communications and organizational skills with the ability to deal with ambiguity while juggling multiple priorities
Experience with Agile methodology for team work and analytics ‘product’ creation. Fluent in ADO, Confluence.
Experience with Azure cloud services is a must.
Experience in Reinforcement Learning is a must.
Experience in Simulation and Optimization problems in any space is a must.
Experience with PYSPARK is a must.
Experience with NLP is a plus.
Experience with LLM is a plus.
Experience with working with FAIR data is a plus.
Experience with Responsible AI is a plus.
Experience with distributed machine learning is a plus

Title: Staff Data Scientist
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

At Preply, data is at the heart of every decision we make. We run hundreds of A/B tests to continually optimize our product, each with its own analytical and tracking challenges. The complexity of our subscription model, along with the unique dynamics of tutor-learner interactions, offers an exciting opportunity for those looking to make a real impact.

As a Staff Data Scientist , you will own the data strategy for a critical product domain (e.g., Growth, Retention, Marketplace) and act as the senior analytical authority in that space. You will partner with Directors and VPs across Product, Engineering, and Business to shape long-term strategy, influence investment decisions, and ensure our roadmap is grounded in rigorous, scalable measurement frameworks.

Our Data Team is dedicated to empowering top-quality decision-making. Do you want to know how? Visit our Tech Radar to learn about the technologies we use at Preply!

What you’ll be doing:


Develop and formalize a strategic understanding of the key value drivers of your domain, including user behavior, marketplace dynamics, pricing, and long-term unit economics - and translate these into actionable decision frameworks used by leadership.
Define the long-term measurement and experimentation strategy for your domain, identifying structural growth levers and step-change opportunities beyond incremental optimization.
Design the experimentation programme in your domain and execute, and evaluate large-scale experiments to test new ideas and measure their effectiveness in driving business outcomes.
Lead deep analytical investigations into customer behavior and retention dynamics, reframing ambiguous business questions into structured analyses that drive step-change improvements in long-term value.
Own impact modeling and scenario analysis for major product initiatives, enabling quarterly and annual planning decisions through robust forecasting, trade-off analysis, and risk assessment.
Own the definition and governance of key metrics within your domain, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with company-level objectives.
Act as a senior thought partner to product, engineering, and data leaders, driving alignment across teams and elevating analytical standards across the organization.
Lead cross-domain analytical initiatives (e.g., company-wide LTV modeling, pricing strategy, marketplace health framework).


What you need to succeed:


Demonstrated track record of materially influencing product or business strategy in complex environments, with clear examples of company-level impact.
Expertise in experimentation and causal inference, including operating under imperfect conditions, resolving ambiguity, and guiding high-stakes decisions where clean experiments are not always feasible.
Strong understanding of subscription and marketplace economics, including LTV modeling, cohort dynamics, retention mechanics, pricing trade-offs, and long-term value optimization.
Strong technical proficiency (e.g., SQL, Python) with the ability to review and elevate the analytical work of others, set coding standards, and design scalable analytical workflows.
Experience mentoring and technically guiding senior data scientists, contributing to the overall growth and maturity of the data organization.
Curiosity, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, as well as the ability to proactively identify and address challenges.
Ability to influence Directors and VP-level stakeholders, navigate conflicting incentives, and drive clarity in high-stakes strategic discussions.
Interest in the bigger picture, feeling excited to impact the product roadmap and strategy.


Nice to have:


Background in 2-sided marketplaces or digital businesses (B2C, B2B2C).
Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap).
Experience applying advanced analytical methods (e.g., forecasting, causal modeling, pricing optimization) to drive structural business improvements.
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field.
Demonstrated experience developing Senior Data Scientists and contributing to raising the analytical bar across teams.


Why you’ll love it at Preply


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Access to free mental health support platforms;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!)


Our Principles


Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
ABOUT US

In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best-in-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.

LIFE AT TKWW

At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life’s most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.

ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:

TKWW is looking for a Senior  Data Scientist to join our team of data professionals supporting our Marketplace. The Senior  Data Scientist will play a critical role in shaping data strategy, guiding experimentation, and driving impact through advanced analytics. They will partner with cross-functional teams—including product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders—to design experiments, develop analytical tools, and ensure we are making data-driven decisions that deliver measurable results. As a trusted advisor and mentor, this person will both lead analyses directly and elevate the work of the broader team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Gather, analyze, and interpret data to deliver business impact and help the organization make informed decisions
Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, causal inference) to uncover insights and guide strategy
Forecast and simulate hypotheticals to provide early potential signals before large initiatives start
Design and analyze A/B and multivariate testing experiments; guide experimentation best practices across teams
Design, build, and maintain reusable, scalable data products and self-serve capabilities used by multiple internal teams
Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations, linking insights to business outcomes such as ROI, conversion, retention, and revenue
Maintain a deep understanding of the product, relevant data assets, and the outcomes of past experiments and analyses
Identify opportunities for new data products and integrations, prioritize a backlog of data assets and use cases, and collaborate with business partners to implement them
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure strong internal customer focus and alignment

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Do you want to start a new professional challenge? Check out our new opportunity!

We are looking to incorporate a Data Scientist to our team.

🤗 About us

We are an IT Consultant Group that provides services and creates digital solutions to improve the lives of citizens across Europe. Check out our website: www.altia.es/en

🚀 Our project and team

This is your opportunity to start working on international projects with a highly qualified team and applying the latest technologies.

You will join our European team, specifically the one involved in several projects for a significant European Agency.

Minimum Requirements

🧠 Required Knowledge


Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques and tools (e.g., Python, R, SAS, Spark) to design and implement data-driven solutions.
Knowledge of machine learning and natural language processing (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face) to build predictive and text-based models.
Knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL; Perl optional) commonly used in data science for modelling and automation.
Knowledge of MLOps practices (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, model registry, unit testing frameworks) to ensure reproducibility and quality in model delivery.
Knowledge of business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, SAS, SAP Analytics) to visualise and communicate model outputs and insights.
Knowledge of data engineering and ETL processes using tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica, dbt, Azure Data Factory) to prepare training datasets.
Knowledge of data storage and query technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, Hadoop) to extract and process data at scale.
High level of English.


✅ Main Responsibilities


Collaborate with stakeholders to collect requirements, frame business problems as data science hypotheses, define success metrics, and develop or deploy advanced data mining and machine learning solutions.
Collaborate with User Experience (UX) and product teams to specify design requirements for the effective presentation and interpretation of model outputs and insights.
Develop process to monitor and analyse data accuracy
Identify, collect, and prepare data for analysis, collaborating with Data Analysts to ensure robust production-grade data pipelines, with a focus on feature engineering and data readiness for modelling.
Produce data models according to specific problems statements.
Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and scripts to solve specific business problems.
Collaborate with Data Analysts and Architects on the design of the analytics architecture to ensure it supports the scalability and performance requirements of data science models.
Write the different documentation associated with the tasks and liaise with other teams as necessary to address cross-system interdependencies.


🔝 Skills:


Ability to frame business problems, form hypotheses, and design solutions.
Skill in presenting models and insights clearly to all audiences.
Commitment to accuracy, reproducibility, and integrity in models.
Ability to design and test approaches for complex challenges.
Competence in managing experiments, pipelines, and deliverables.
Drive to explore new algorithms, frameworks, and AI methods.
Ability to interpret analytical findings to tell a compelling story that clearly prescribes business actions and drives strategic decision-making.
Ability to understand, speak and write English, optionally French as an additional asset.


This job offer has been drafted with impartiality and non-discrimination on the basis of gender, race, ideology or any other grounds in mind. In particular, it complies with current regulations on gender equality between women and men (Royal Decree-Law 6/2019)

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Como uno de nuestros Data Scientists de Juegos

Serás una de las personas clave que ayuda a transformar preguntas de negocio en insights accionables. Investigarás y analizarás el comportamiento de los jugadores para generar recomendaciones basadas en datos. Para ello, escucharás a los distintos miembros del equipo, comprenderás el contexto y cuestionarás ideas de negocio cuando sea necesario.

Nuestros Data Scientists utilizan una amplia variedad de técnicas, como estadística frecuentista y bayesiana, machine learning, análisis exploratorio y explicativo de datos, inferencia causal, visualización de datos, modelización Monte Carlo, análisis econométrico, entre otras. La amplitud de estas responsabilidades requiere una gran capacidad de aprendizaje, eficiencia en el trabajo colaborativo y habilidad para comunicar datos e insights de forma clara y efectiva.

Los Data Scientists de Juegos son profesionales que impulsan la toma de decisiones de negocio mediante el uso de datos y análisis profundos.

Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con conjuntos de datos grandes y complejos, disfrutando de la autonomía necesaria para generar un impacto significativo en el éxito de nuestros juegos. Además, formarás parte de un equipo experimentado y altamente cualificado de aproximadamente 20 profesionales, con múltiples oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo.

Qué harás


Colaborar con los stakeholders para entender y definir los requisitos de análisis.
Realizar análisis exploratorios de datos y convertir los hallazgos en preguntas que puedan responderse mediante técnicas analíticas.
Utilizar analítica avanzada, métodos estadísticos, inferencia causal, machine learning u otras técnicas para responder preguntas y resolver problemas de negocio.
Comunicar los resultados de forma clara y efectiva.
Gestionar requisitos poco definidos o ambiguos.
Explicar análisis complejos e ideas técnicas de manera sencilla y comprensible.
Trabajar de forma autónoma en proyectos complejos.
Mantener una actitud de aprendizaje continuo, adquiriendo nuevas habilidades y metodologías relacionadas con la ciencia de datos, la comunicación o la gestión de stakeholders.
Utilizar una amplia variedad de herramientas y enfoques de ciencia de datos.


Qué buscamos


Titulación universitaria o experiencia equivalente en un área orientada a los datos.
Capacidad para utilizar técnicas de visualización de datos con el fin de comunicar análisis e insights de manera efectiva.
Experiencia utilizando alguna de las siguientes disciplinas para responder preguntas de negocio o científicas: estadística, matemáticas, machine learning, econometría, inferencia causal, modelización Monte Carlo, entre otras.
Experiencia trabajando con R y/o Python.
Conocimientos y experiencia en SQL.

Title: AI Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist- AI




Barcelona, Spain

Hybrid- 2 days a week




We’re looking for a Data Scientist to help build and improve AI‑powered document processing solutions used across a large, complex organisation. You’ll work across LLMs, multimodal models, OCR, NLP and classical ML to turn messy, unstructured business documents into reliable structured data that drives real value.

In this role, you’ll design and evaluate approaches for document extraction, classification and validation — “Design, prototype and evaluate approaches for document extraction, classification, validation and transformation.” You’ll also work with highly variable formats — “Work with complex and variable formats, including multi‑page documents, tables, line items and inconsistent layouts.”




What you’ll do

Develop and optimise prompts, structured outputs, validation logic and post‑processing components.
Compare LLMs, multimodal models, OCR and deterministic approaches to select the right solution for each use case.
Build representative datasets, define ground truth and establish robust evaluation metrics.
Run experiments, analyse failure patterns and iterate to improve accuracy and reliability.
Create reproducible Python workflows and contribute reusable components for extraction, validation and data prep.
Collaborate with Product, AI Engineering and business teams to translate requirements into measurable data science problems.
Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences.




What you’ll bring

3+ years in data science, machine learning or applied AI.
Hands‑on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering and experimentation.
Strong NLP/ML fundamentals and the judgement to know when classical methods outperform LLMs.
Solid statistics — enough to judge whether a performance change is real.
Experience with unstructured or semi‑structured documents.
Python skills that make your work reproducible and easy for engineers to productionise.
Good coding practices: testing, version control, code review, reproducible experiments.
Ability to explain technical trade‑offs clearly.
Comfortable diving into business domains to understand what “correct extraction” actually means.




Nice to have

Document intelligence / OCR (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence).
Experience with managed AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock).

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
¡Hola! Somos OGA




Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo.




Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico.




Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico.




Sobre la posición.




Buscamos un/a Senior Data Scientist con experiencia en la investigación, análisis y modelado de datos para identificar patrones y tendencias clave, impulsando la toma de decisiones estratégicas en la organización, para unirse a nuestro equipo.




¿Qué harás?





Análisis de datos y desarrollo de aplicaciones de optimización de procesos complejos con técnicas tanto de Inteligencia Artificial como de Investigación Operativa, utilizando entre otros, lenguajes de programación como Python, Java, JavaScript o C++.


Analizar, depurar, transformar, visualizar, etc. los datos disponibles para proyectos de IA, utilizando las herramientas y tecnologías necesarias en cada caso concreto.


Realizar el EDA (Exploratory Data Analysis) de los datos para proporcionar un buen conjunto de datos a los modelos de IA.


Utilización de diferentes modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, los cuales serán entrenados, validados y testados en función de los objetivos de cada proyecto.


Tuning de modelos ML/DL.


Investigación e implementación de algoritmos y herramientas de ML/DL.


Implementación del pipeline completo de un modelo de ML/DL (Datasource, Limpieza datos, Ingeniería de Variables, Entrenamientos, Validación, Puesta en producción y Monitorización/Operación).


Analizarás bases de datos utilizando técnicas de análisis estadístico avanzado.


Desarrollarás soluciones y modelos avanzados de Inteligencia Artificial.


Elaborarás documentación técnica relacionada con los proyectos.





Timing de primeras semanas en OGA




Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación.




¿Qué requerimos?





Titulación en Máster en Matemáticas / Estadística / Ingeniería / Ciencias de la Computación o área relacionada (valorable Doctorado).


Experiencia de más de 5 años en el sector de Inteligencia Artificial, incluyendo al menos 3 años como consultor senior liderando proyectos complejos y horizontales con exposición al negocio, con experiencia en tratamiento de datos (captura, almacenamiento, normalización, limpieza, visualización, ETLs y modelos de datos) e implementación de soluciones de IA utilizando Machine Learning y Deep Learning, aplicando algoritmos supervisados, no supervisados y auto-explicativos, como RandomForest, CatBoost, XGBoost, CNN y RNN.


Conocimiento y dominio experto en Python (valorable experiencia en otras plataformas y lenguajes), conocimientos recomendables en bases de datos como Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL y MS SQL/SQL Azure, así como experiencia en el entorno de desarrollo de Microsoft Azure. Nivel Alto de inglés.





¿Qué valoramos?





Airflow, Hadoop, Spark, MongoDB.


Interés por el desarrollo de una carrera técnica y vocación por la especiación tecnológica.


Pasión por la tecnología y por la creación de valor para el cliente.


Capacidad de relación con equipos de negocio y funcionales, visión holística del problema de negocio a resolver.


Orientación a resultados, proactividad, trabajo en equipo.


Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional de manera esporádica.

Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.


Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.


Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.


Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.


Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.


Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.


Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.


Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Sin embargo, serás tú quien debe tomar la iniciativa en tu propio desarrollo, identificando aquello que te apasiona y proponiendo a tu responsable las formaciones que desees realizar. Juntos evaluareis su viabilidad, su aporte de valor y su alineación con la estrategia de OGA.


Compromiso con la inclusión y la diversidad. En OGA nos tomamos muy en serio el talento. Creemos que cada persona aporta algo único y especial, por lo que es parte de nuestro compromiso ofrecer un ambiente donde todos podáis brillar.


Beneficios sociales y profesionales integrados en un plan global de conciliación. Como ‘entidad familiarmente responsable’ - efr - desde 2015, certificada por la Fundación Másfamilia, en OGA hemos desarrollado un amplio catálogo de beneficios para tu bienestar personal y profesional.

¡Te esperamos!

Title: Data Scientist, Parameta Solutions (Madrid)
Description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

About Parameta Solutions

Parameta Solutions is the Data & Analytics division of TP ICAP Group. The business provides clients with unbiased OTC content and proprietary data, in-depth insights across price discovery, risk management, benchmark and indices, and pre and post-trade analytics. Its post-trade solutions offering helps market participants control their counterparty and regulatory risks through a growing range of tools that manage balance-sheet exposure, as well as compression and optimisation services. The Data & Analytics division includes the following brands: Tullett Prebon Information, PVM Data Services, ICAP Information and Burton-Taylor Consulting.

Role Overview

We are on a mission to harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to shape the next generation of financial intelligence solutions. As we continue to expand our Data Science capability, we are seeking a talented and innovative Data Scientist to develop cutting-edge analytical and Generative AI solutions that drive commercial value across our business.

Based in Madrid and working within Parameta Solutions, you will play a key role in designing, developing and deploying scalable data products that transform complex financial data into actionable insights. Working closely with Data Engineering, Product, Commercial and Technology teams, you will leverage advanced analytics, cloud technologies and Generative AI capabilities to support the evolution of our data-driven product suite.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a rapidly growing function at the forefront of financial data innovation, helping to shape the future of analytics, intelligence and AI-powered solutions across the organisation.

Role Responsibilities


Design, develop and maintain robust Python-based applications for financial data analysis, transformation, enrichment and automation.
Build scalable data science solutions that extract actionable insights from large and complex financial datasets.
Develop interactive dashboards, monitoring frameworks and visualisation tools to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Enhance, support and continuously improve existing data applications, data quality frameworks and analytical platforms.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Managers and commercial stakeholders to ensure the scalability, reliability and usability of data products and models.
Apply software engineering best practices, including modular development, code reviews, automated testing, version control and CI/CD methodologies.
Design, develop and maintain Generative AI solutions that enhance internal processes, analytical capabilities and customer-facing products.
Leverage AWS cloud technologies and services to build scalable AI and machine learning applications, making full use of innovative capabilities available through our strategic AWS partnership.
Evaluate emerging AI, machine learning and data science technologies, identifying opportunities to improve products, processes and client outcomes.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Parameta Solutions' data science and AI capabilities, helping establish best practices and technical standards across the team.


Experience / Competences

Essential


Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or another quantitative discipline.
Proven experience developing production-grade Python applications within a data science, machine learning or quantitative analytics environment.
Demonstrated software engineering fundamentals including object-oriented programming, modular design patterns and version control.
Experience building and deploying analytical, machine learning or AI-driven solutions in a commercial environment.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying and manipulating large-scale datasets.
Experience working with modern data and engineering platforms such as Snowflake, Airflow, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience developing or integrating Generative AI, Large Language Model (LLM) or machine learning solutions.
Demonstrated understanding of cloud-based architectures and services, particularly within AWS environments.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.


Desired


Industry experience in a computational or quantitative data science role.
Experience developing customer-facing analytics, recommendation engines or AI-powered products.
Knowledge of MLOps practices and model deployment, monitoring and governance frameworks.
Experience working within agile product and engineering environments.
Passion for emerging technologies and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.


Job Band & Level


Professional / 5


#PARAMETA

Not The Perfect Fit?

Concerned that you may not meet the criteria precisely? At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.

Company Statement

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord - our Employee Network - is a central to this. As well as representing specific groups, TP ICAP Accord helps increase awareness, collaboration, shares best practice, and holds our firm to account for driving continuous cultural improvement.

Location

Spain - Paseo de la Castellana - Madrid

Title: Data Scientist - Fraud Detection
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Scientist to join our Anti Fraud Team.

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to tackle fraud, one of the most impactful and fast-evolving challenges in insurance. You will do this from a global perspective. In fact, the team is responsible for detecting fraudulent claims across all Prima markets: the UK, Spain and Italy.

You’ll collaborate with engineers, claims handlers and business leaders to improve the detection of fraud, directly influencing real-world fraud decisions with impact on the company’s bottom line measured in millions. This is a highly practical area of work where strong business judgment is just as important as technical expertise.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


Design and improve fraud detection systems that prioritize high-risk claims, optimizing the trade-off between detection accuracy and operational efficiency
Collaborate across teams and functions, working closely with fraud analysts, engineers, and product managers
Develop deep expertise in fraud dynamics, identifying emerging fraud patterns, understanding how they evolve across the insurance lifecycle, and translating these insights into effective detection and prevention strategies, for example identifying suspicious networks of related claims, synthetic entities, or anomalous behavioral patterns


What We’re Looking For


Extensive experience (3+ years) in data science or applied machine learning, leading end-to-end initiatives in complex technical domains and delivering measurable business impact
Strong analytical and quantitative mindset able to translate data into insights, assess model performance, and guide decision-making with evidence and clarity
Structured problem solver skilled at framing ambiguous challenges, defining success metrics, and communicating results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong Python programming skills, especially in the data domain, and fluent use of Git
Knowledge of Spark, SQL or any other data-oriented programming language and proficiency with standard data wrangling and modeling libraries (Pandas, Sklearn, Keras, XGBoost, LightGBM, etc.)


Nice-to-Have


Experience in analytical fraud detection in the Insurance, Finance or Law Enforcement domain
In-depth knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) and analytics (NetworkX, GNN) or explainability applied to anomaly detection
Knowledge of BI tools (Tableau or similar)


€45,000 - €65,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵 Competitive compensation: We offer a performance-based bonus of up to 5% of the fixed salary for this position.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
At ThetaRay, our purpose is to make the world a safer place by protecting the integrity of the global financial system. We do this by putting AI at the core of both our technology and our way of working.




Our AI-driven solutions help banks and fintech companies worldwide detect and stop serious financial crime, from human trafficking and terrorist financing to sophisticated money laundering, while advanced technology, automation, and AI-driven tools help our teams collaborate smarter, move faster, and continuously improve how we build, deliver, and innovate.




About the role:




We are looking for a Data Scientist to turn expertise, initiative, and bold thinking into real impact on the next generation of AI-driven financial crime detection. If you combine strong data science and machine learning capabilities with the ability to translate complex technical solutions into real business value for customers, and if you are motivated by leading end-to-end implementations that sit at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and the world's most critical financial crime challenges, ThetaRay could be your next challenge.




Responsibilities:




• Deliver successful deployment and Pilots

• Manage and design the Customer-specific technical solution throughout the project life cycle

• Technical leadership of Data Science and engineering aspects and team members including partners

• Work on various data sources and apply sophisticated feature engineering capabilities

• Bring and use business knowledge

• Extract insights and actionable recommendations from large volumes of data and Investigate anomalies in Big Data

• Build and manage technical relationships with customers and partners

• Provide product requirements input to the Product Management team

• Train the customers on the system – system usage and monitoring aspects

• Travel to customer locations both domestically and abroad




Requirements:




• 2+ years of experience as a data scientist/data engineer/big-data developer

• BSc or equivalent in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or another related field

• Must have proven professional experience in data analytics for financial services with strong data mining and forensic skills

• Experience working with customers - an advantage

• Must have Hands-on experience and knowledge of scripting languages: Python/PySpark as well as DS workflow management tools including MLflow, Airflow, etc.

• Experience in NLP or Graph Algorithms - an advantage

• Working experience with Linux OS - an advantage

• Fluent English - written and spoken




Core Competencies:




• Able to solve tech problems for customers; improvise; cope with unexpected challenges

• Able to drive relevant internal functions to deliver/solve a problem for customers/partners

• A motivated, self-starter who can demonstrate high analytical and technical skills

• Ability to design creative solutions for complex requirements

• Ability to learn and lead projects independently, and to work with minimal supervision with customers (tech & business)

• Strong interpersonal relationship building

• Ability to execute multiple projects and drive key business results under tight deadlines

En AXPE Consulting buscamos incorporar Data Scientists para participar en un proyecto estratégico dentro del área de Data & AI de una de las principales entidades financieras de España.




El proyecto estará centrado en el desarrollo de soluciones avanzadas de Customer Analytics y Machine Learning, trabajando conjuntamente con equipos de Data, CRM y negocio.




🎯 ¿Cuál será tu misión?

Participarás en la definición y construcción de un motor de recomendación de productos de protección, cuyo objetivo será identificar las necesidades de cada cliente, detectar posibles gaps y determinar qué productos o acciones pueden cubrirlos.

Analizar y explotar grandes volúmenes de información.
Realizar clusterización y segmentación de clientes a partir de la información disponible.
Diseñar y desarrollar modelos de Machine Learning.
Contrastar los resultados de los modelos con los equipos de CRM y negocio.
Evaluar la incorporación de reglas de negocio para mejorar las soluciones propuestas.
Definir y desarrollar nuevos modelos predictivos de fuga/churn.
Trabajar con modelos de aprendizaje automático supervisados.
Realizar selección de variables, entrenamiento, validación y ajuste de hiperparámetros.
Evaluar el rendimiento de los modelos mediante las métricas correspondientes.
Trabajar con algoritmos como K-Means, KNN y otras técnicas de clasificación y clustering.
Identificar perfiles similares mediante técnicas de lookalike modelling / identificación de clientes gemelos.
Participar en iniciativas de Speech Analytics para la extracción de eventos y señales accionables.
Generar insights que puedan traducirse en acciones concretas de negocio.
Documentar los análisis, procesos, modelos y resultados desarrollados.
Elaborar y presentar informes con las principales conclusiones del proyecto.
Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinares de Data, Tecnología, CRM y Negocio.

Titulación universitaria en Matemáticas, Física, Estadística, Ingeniería o estudios similares de carácter cuantitativo.
Al menos 3 años de experiencia como Data Scientist o en posiciones similares.
Experiencia profesional trabajando con Python.
Buen dominio de SQL.
Experiencia trabajando con Databricks.
Experiencia desarrollando modelos de Machine Learning supervisados.

Preparación y análisis de datos.
Feature Engineering.
Entrenamiento de modelos.
Ajuste de hiperparámetros.
Validación.
Evaluación de rendimiento.
Experiencia con algoritmos y técnicas como:
K-Means.
KNN.
Clustering.
Clasificación.
Segmentación.
Capacidad para interpretar los resultados de los modelos y trasladarlos a conclusiones relevantes para negocio.
Buenas capacidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.
Autonomía, flexibilidad y capacidad de adaptación.




⭐ Valoraremos especialmente

Experiencia en Customer Analytics, CRM, Pricing o Modelos.
Desarrollo de modelos de churn, propensión, recomendación o segmentación de clientes.
Experiencia previa en el sector seguros o productos de protección.
Experiencia en banca o servicios financieros.
PySpark / Spark / SparkML.
Experiencia con librerías o frameworks de Deep Learning.
Conocimientos de Linux, Bash y Crontab.
Experiencia trabajando bajo metodologías Agile.




🛠 Stack tecnológico

Python | SQL | Databricks | Machine Learning | K-Means | KNN | Clustering | Predictive Modelling | Spark / SparkML

Te incorporarás a un squad de Data Scientists, participando en un proyecto de Data & AI con una clara aplicación de los modelos desarrollados sobre decisiones reales de negocio.




Buscamos perfiles con una combinación de solidez técnica, capacidad analítica y orientación a negocio, especialmente interesados en aplicar Machine Learning sobre problemas reales de comportamiento y necesidades de clientes.

Title: Data Scientist & ML Engineer (Applied AI for Industry)
Description:
Job Description

Are you ready to embark on a challenging journey of discovering and applying novel Machine Learning and AI-driven solutions in process monitoring, control and optimization for products in different industrial sectors?

The Applied Artificial Intelligence Unit of EURECAT is looking for a highly motivated Data Scientist and Machine Learning engineer to help us pave the way in transforming products and industries to create a smarter, more sustainable future.


Whether it’s algorithms or data analytics, we’re here to revolutionize the industrial sector.
Enriching product functionalities by developing cutting edge data driven solutions
Industrial Control Systems: from single automation devices to complex machines, we’re exploring AI-based approaches across various levels of industrial control systems: Computer vision, Sensor fusion, model predictive control, self-optimizing processes, surrogate modelling, LLM, Agentic AI, etc.
Collaboration: Join our multidisciplinary team. Learn, grow, and contribute. Be part of the ML-driven industrial revolution



Responsabilities

As a valued member of our team, your role encompasses several critical dimensions:


Code Craftsmanship: Your code will be the bedrock of our innovations. Rigorous validation and refinement ensure optimal efficiency and ready-to market solutions
Innovative Solutions: You’ll delve into the intricate world of data-driven solutions, harnessing the power of multimodal data across industrial contexts.
GenAI: Large Language Models are changing the way we interact with data driven solutions, be part of the Agents era for industrial applications
Modelling industrial settings require novel approaches. Be ready to work with GNNs and PINNs
TimeSeries analytics: Expect to wield advanced tools like Recurrent Neural Networks and Autoencoders.
Global Impact: Collaborate on scientific publications, sharing your insights with the wider research community.
Tailored Growth: We recognize your unique strengths and interests. Your responsibilities will evolve accordingly, fostering personalized development within our team.
Project Leadership: As you grow and the projects unfold, your adept project management skills will steer us toward success.



WORKING ENVIRONMENT AND BENEFITS:

This position is located either in Barcelona (Poblenou) or in Cerdanyola del Vallès, near Barcelona (Spain). Besides being well connected to the rest of Europe, Barcelona area offers an excellent quality of life and a vibrant technology ecosystem, with leading research centres, innovative companies, active communities, and a wide range of events and networking opportunities.

Additionally, we offer:


Permanent contract.
Hybrid work model (home office and office-based work).
Flexible working hours, shorter Fridays, and intensive summer working schedules.
Flexible remuneration package (health insurance, transport, meal vouchers, training, and childcare).
Professional development through Eurecat Academy courses, weekly knowledge-sharing sessions, and language training (English, Catalan, and Spanish).



Requirements:

Academic Background


Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Chemistry, Agronomy, or similar.
Desirable studies or specialization (Master’s, Postgraduate, or PhD) in Data Science, AI, Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, or similar.



Required Skills And Experience


A passion for DataScience and ML, backed by an MSc or equivalent experience in ML, AI, Computer Vision, or a related field.
Excellent coding skills. Your code will be used in ready-to-market AI applications.
Proficiency in Python.
At least 2 years of hands-on experience with Machine Learning, Deep Learning, with a track record of applying AI techniques.
A collaborative and growing mindset, coupled with the ability to thrive both independently and as part of a team.
Open minded: Eager to learn new domains: how the industrial processes work and its fine details.
Dynamic communication skills, allowing you to effectively convey complex ideas and collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Flexibility, creativity, and a relentless drive to innovate.
Critical thinking.
A readiness to travel when needed, embracing opportunities to connect with clients, partners, and collaborators worldwide.

Description:
Somos una compañía global, líder en el desarrollo de infraestructuras regenerativas que generan un impacto positivo en la sociedad. Nuestra plantilla, formada por más de 65.000 profesionales y presente en más de 40 países de los cinco continentes, contribuye a nuestra misión de diseñar un planeta mejor. Buscamos personas que quieran marcar la diferencia, promover el desarrollo sostenible y encontrar soluciones a los mayores desafíos globales, incluidos el cambio climático, la sobrepoblación y la escasez hídrica. Únete a nosotros en la búsqueda de soluciones para lograr un futuro sostenible.

ACCIONA, en su división de Infraestructuras, precisa incorporar un/a Data Scientist Technician en su Campus de Madrid.

Descripción del puesto

Misión: Desarrollar e implementar soluciones avanzadas de inteligencia artificial y machine learning que permitan extraer valor de los datos, optimizar procesos y mejorar la toma de decisiones en las distintas áreas de negocio, contribuyendo a la generación de impacto tangible y a la evolución de las capacidades analíticas de la organización.

Funciones


Desarrollar e implementar modelos de machine learning e inteligencia artificial, aplicando técnicas avanzadas para la predicción, optimización y toma de decisiones basada en datos.
Diseñar y ejecutar análisis estadísticos avanzados sobre grandes volúmenes de datos, identificando patrones, tendencias y relaciones relevantes.
Construir y optimizar pipelines de datos, incluyendo procesos de ingesta, limpieza y transformación, garantizando la calidad y disponibilidad de la información.
Aplicar técnicas avanzadas de IA sobre datos no estructurados (NLP, visión por computador, deep learning) en proyectos de alto impacto.
Evaluar el rendimiento de los modelos mediante métricas y técnicas de validación, asegurando su robustez y capacidad de generalización.
Colaborar en la industrialización de modelos, trabajando con diferentes equipos para su despliegue en entornos productivos.
Generar insights accionables y comunicar resultados a negocio mediante visualizaciones y storytelling de datos.
Colaborar con equipos de negocio, datos e IT en la definición de soluciones analíticas que maximicen el impacto de la IA.
Asegurar la aplicación de buenas prácticas en ciencia de datos, incluyendo documentación, reproducibilidad y calidad de los modelos.
Contribuir a la innovación en técnicas de IA, incorporando nuevas metodologías y tendencias al ámbito de la organización.


Requisitos del candidato

Requisitos


Grado en Matemáticas, Ingeniería Informática, Ciencia de Datos o similar.
Valorable Máster o Posgrado en Data Science, IA o Analytics.
Experiencia de 3 años en proyectos de ciencia de datos o inteligencia artificial.
Conocimientos en:
Lenguajes de programación: Python, R o similares.
Frameworks de machine learning: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn.
Procesamiento de datos: SQL, Spark, Hadoop.
Cloud: AWS, Azure o Google Cloud.
Herramientas de visualización: Power BI, Tableau o similares.


Nivel de inglés: C1.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 

 

About the Role

The Data Science department plays a pivotal role in our company, generating value to Riskified by developing algorithms and analytical production-grade solutions. We leverage advanced techniques and algorithms to provide maximum value from data in all shapes and sizes (such as classification models, NLP, anomaly detection, graph theory, deep learning, and more). As a Data Scientist, you will assume the classic data-science role of an end-to-end project development and implementation practitioner. Being part of the team requires a mix of hard quantitative and analytical skills, solid background in statistical modeling and machine learning, a technical data-savvy nature, along with a passion for problem-solving and a desire to drive data-driven decision-making.


 

What You'll Be Doing
Data Exploration and Preprocessing: Collect, clean, and transform large, complex data sets from various sources to ensure data quality and integrity for analysis
Statistical Analysis and Modeling: Apply statistical methods and mathematical models to identify patterns, trends, and relationships in data sets, and develop predictive models
Machine Learning: Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, such as classification, regression, clustering, and deep learning, to solve business problems and improve processes
Feature Engineering: Extract relevant features from structured and unstructured data sources, and design and engineer new features to enhance model performance
Model Development and Evaluation: Build, train, and optimize machine learning models using state-of-the-art techniques, and evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics
Data Visualization: Present complex analysis results in a clear and concise manner using data visualization techniques, and communicate insights to stakeholders effectively
Collaborative Problem-Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, data engineers, software developers, and business stakeholders to identify data-driven solutions and implement them in production environments
Research and Innovation: Stay up to date with the latest advancements in data science, machine learning, and related fields, and proactively explore new approaches to enhance the company's analytical capabilities

 

Qualifications
B.Sc (M.Sc is a plus) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
3+ years of proven experience designing and implementing machine learning algorithms and successfully deploying them to production.
Strong understanding and practical experience with various machine learning algorithms.
Proficiency in Python, Experience with SQL and data manipulation tools (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) to extract, clean, and transform data for analysis
Solid foundation in statistical concepts and techniques, including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time series analysis, and experimental design
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to approach business problems, formulate hypotheses, and translate them into actionable solutions
Proficiency in data visualization libraries, to create meaningful visual representations of complex data
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to present complex findings and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, collaborate with colleagues, and contribute to a positive work environment
Advantages:
Experience in the fraud domain
Experience with Airflow, CircleCI, PySpark, Docker and K8S

We include transparent salary ranges to support fairness, clarity, and informed decision-making early in the process. The base salary range for this position is €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually for candidates based in Lisbon. Your actual salary will be determined based on your unique skills, experience, and competencies. If your expectations differ, please let us know - we’re always open to a conversation.

The base salary is one part of the total compensation package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Also, our value proposition goes way beyond compensation: our perks and benefits package, culture, community, and learning and development programs are just some of the elements we provide to bring value to our employees.

We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking.

About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 

 

About the Role

The Data Science department plays a pivotal role in our company, generating value to Riskified by developing algorithms and analytical production-grade solutions. We leverage advanced techniques and algorithms to provide maximum value from data in all shapes and sizes (such as classification models, NLP, anomaly detection, graph theory, deep learning, and more). As a Data Scientist, you will assume the classic data-science role of an end-to-end project development and implementation practitioner. Being part of the team requires a mix of hard quantitative and analytical skills, solid background in statistical modeling and machine learning, a technical data-savvy nature, along with a passion for problem-solving and a desire to drive data-driven decision-making.

 

What You'll Be Doing
  • Data Exploration and Preprocessing: Collect, clean, and transform large, complex data sets from various sources to ensure data quality and integrity for analysis
  • Statistical Analysis and Modeling: Apply statistical methods and mathematical models to identify patterns, trends, and relationships in data sets, and develop predictive models
  • Machine Learning: Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, such as classification, regression, clustering, and deep learning, to solve business problems and improve processes
  • Feature Engineering: Extract relevant features from structured and unstructured data sources, and design and engineer new features to enhance model performance
  • Model Development and Evaluation: Build, train, and optimize machine learning models using state-of-the-art techniques, and evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics
  • Data Visualization: Present complex analysis results in a clear and concise manner using data visualization techniques, and communicate insights to stakeholders effectively
  • Collaborative Problem-Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, data engineers, software developers, and business stakeholders to identify data-driven solutions and implement them in production environments
  • Research and Innovation: Stay up to date with the latest advancements in data science, machine learning, and related fields, and proactively explore new approaches to enhance the company's analytical capabilities

 

Qualifications
  • B.Sc (M.Sc is a plus) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
  • 3+ years of proven experience designing and implementing machine learning algorithms and successfully deploying them to production.
  • Strong understanding and practical experience with various machine learning algorithms.
  • Proficiency in Python, Experience with SQL and data manipulation tools (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) to extract, clean, and transform data for analysis
  • Solid foundation in statistical concepts and techniques, including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time series analysis, and experimental design
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to approach business problems, formulate hypotheses, and translate them into actionable solutions
  • Proficiency in data visualization libraries, to create meaningful visual representations of complex data
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to present complex findings and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, collaborate with colleagues, and contribute to a positive work environment
Advantages:
  • Experience in the fraud domain
  • Experience with Airflow, CircleCI, PySpark, Docker and K8S

We include transparent salary ranges to support fairness, clarity, and informed decision-making early in the process. The base salary range for this position is €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually for candidates based in Lisbon. Your actual salary will be determined based on your unique skills, experience, and competencies. If your expectations differ, please let us know - we’re always open to a conversation.
