Title: Senior Software Engineer
Description:
Join us as a Sr. Software Engineer on the R&D Software Team and own real software from the ground up — not a ticket queue. You'll shape the roadmap, make the technical calls, and build the real-time data platform that turns industrial IoT telemetry into decisions our customers can act on.

Where You'll Work: This is a remote-friendly role — most of your work in practice can be done remotely, with occasional in-person collaboration at our Porto office. Our engineers tell us that flexibility is one of the things they value most about working here.

Job Duties and Responsibilities: Reporting to the Digital Integration Director, you will own software solutions end to end, from framing the business problem to running services reliably in production, built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors monitoring liquid and gas storage tanks across industries including industrial chemical, industrial gas, propane, and other fuels. Collaborate for success


Own projects end to end, starting from a greenfield state: define your own requirements, shape the roadmap, and take solutions through to production.
Work cross-functionally with teams like Sales and Marketing, translating business goals into working software.
Make the technical decisions and contribute significantly to the implementation — this is a hands-on role, not a hand-off-to-others one.


Build data-driven systems


Build and operate the backend services and APIs behind a platform ingesting real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors at sites across the globe.
Design and run the data pipelines that turn that telemetry into something people can act on — including forecasting and anomaly detection on time series.
Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, irregular sampling, and a device population that keeps evolving. Bring the statistical judgment to tell a real signal from noise, and to say how confident we should be.
Run what you build — instrumentation, alerting, and the operational habits that keep a system healthy.


Engineer with AI assistance


Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
Structure repositories, tests, and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any system whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.


Advocate for quality


Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across software engineering, data engineering, and platform operations, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.


What Success Looks Like


Backend services and data pipelines for real-time IoT telemetry run reliably in production, with strong instrumentation and alerting in place.
Forecasting and anomaly detection outputs are trustworthy enough that customers and internal stakeholders act on them with confidence.
Engineering practices — code review, testing, CI/CD, AI-assisted development — visibly raise the team's baseline, not just this person's own output.
Other engineers are actively mentored and leveled up through code review and design discussion.
Business stakeholders trust this person to translate technical trade-offs and uncertainty into decisions they can act on.


What you'll need to succeed: Minimum Requirements -


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or scientific field — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5+ years in software engineering or a closely related role, including hands-on production deployment (6–8 years preferred). A completed PhD in a quantitative or scientific discipline, with substantial hands-on programming, counts toward this.
Strong Python and the engineering habits that go with it: git, code review, linters, unit tests, and CI/CD pipelines are things you use daily.
Strong analytical ability and working fluency with statistics: distributions, uncertainty, correlation and causation, and knowing when a result is real.
Solid SQL and experience working with data at scale — pandas, PySpark, and platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Postgres.
Experience operating software in production: deployment, monitoring, alerting, and a feel for the practices that make that sustainable.
Fluency with agentic coding tools.
Fluent in written and spoken English.


Preferred Qualifications -


Depth in the Azure Databricks platform: PySpark, streaming pipelines.
Time series work in production: forecasting, anomaly detection, or similar.
Experience with message queuing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
Experience implementing agentic workflows in production — building them, not just calling them.
Hands-on with an agent framework: LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MetaGPT, or similar. We care that you have shipped one, not which one.
Familiarity with the interoperability protocols — MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent2Agent) — for exposing systems as tools other agents can call directly, and for getting agents to talk to each other.
Experience with Microsoft Foundry for building, evaluating, and deploying agents.
Domain experience in industrial, energy, or IoT settings.


About Anova

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. Join us as a Sr. Software Engineer on the R&D Software Team and own real software from the ground up — not a ticket queue. You'll shape the roadmap, make the technical calls, and build the real-time data platform that turns industrial IoT telemetry into decisions our customers can act on.

Where You'll Work: This is a remote-friendly role — most of your work in practice can be done remotely, with occasional in-person collaboration at our Porto office. Our engineers tell us that flexibility is one of the things they value most about working here.

Job Duties and Responsibilities: Reporting to the Digital Integration Director, you will own software solutions end to end, from framing the business problem to running services reliably in production, built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors monitoring liquid and gas storage tanks across industries including industrial chemical, industrial gas, propane, and other fuels. Collaborate for success

  • Own projects end to end, starting from a greenfield state: define your own requirements, shape the roadmap, and take solutions through to production.
  • Work cross-functionally with teams like Sales and Marketing, translating business goals into working software.
  • Make the technical decisions and contribute significantly to the implementation — this is a hands-on role, not a hand-off-to-others one.

Build data-driven systems

  • Build and operate the backend services and APIs behind a platform ingesting real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors at sites across the globe.
  • Design and run the data pipelines that turn that telemetry into something people can act on — including forecasting and anomaly detection on time series.
  • Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, irregular sampling, and a device population that keeps evolving. Bring the statistical judgment to tell a real signal from noise, and to say how confident we should be.
  • Run what you build — instrumentation, alerting, and the operational habits that keep a system healthy.

Engineer with AI assistance

  • Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
  • Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
  • Structure repositories, tests, and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
  • Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any system whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.

Advocate for quality

  • Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across software engineering, data engineering, and platform operations, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.

What Success Looks Like

  • Backend services and data pipelines for real-time IoT telemetry run reliably in production, with strong instrumentation and alerting in place.
  • Forecasting and anomaly detection outputs are trustworthy enough that customers and internal stakeholders act on them with confidence.
  • Engineering practices — code review, testing, CI/CD, AI-assisted development — visibly raise the team's baseline, not just this person's own output.
  • Other engineers are actively mentored and leveled up through code review and design discussion.
  • Business stakeholders trust this person to translate technical trade-offs and uncertainty into decisions they can act on.

What you'll need to succeed: Minimum Requirements -

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or scientific field — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5+ years in software engineering or a closely related role, including hands-on production deployment (6–8 years preferred). A completed PhD in a quantitative or scientific discipline, with substantial hands-on programming, counts toward this.
  • Strong Python and the engineering habits that go with it: git, code review, linters, unit tests, and CI/CD pipelines are things you use daily.
  • Strong analytical ability and working fluency with statistics: distributions, uncertainty, correlation and causation, and knowing when a result is real.
  • Solid SQL and experience working with data at scale — pandas, PySpark, and platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Postgres.
  • Experience operating software in production: deployment, monitoring, alerting, and a feel for the practices that make that sustainable.
  • Fluency with agentic coding tools.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications -

  • Depth in the Azure Databricks platform: PySpark, streaming pipelines.
  • Time series work in production: forecasting, anomaly detection, or similar.
  • Experience with message queuing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
  • Experience implementing agentic workflows in production — building them, not just calling them.
  • Hands-on with an agent framework: LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MetaGPT, or similar. We care that you have shipped one, not which one.
  • Familiarity with the interoperability protocols — MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent2Agent) — for exposing systems as tools other agents can call directly, and for getting agents to talk to each other.
  • Experience with Microsoft Foundry for building, evaluating, and deploying agents.
  • Domain experience in industrial, energy, or IoT settings.

About Anova

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

Title: Data Analyst – Commercial (m/f/d)
HTML:
Chemical Industry | Data Analyst – Commercial


Your new Company


Elementis, a Global Specialty Chemicals company with a heritage dating back over 175 years, employs around 1 000 people and operates across multiple continents, serving customers worldwide. Specializing in advanced materials and formulation technologies, Elementis delivers high-performance solutions across personal care, coatings, and industrial and consumer applications.


Elementis’ diverse teams collaborate seamlessly across geographies and functions, combining scientific expertise with a strong culture of innovation, integrity, and sustainability to deliver outstanding value to their customers.


Your new Role


The Data Analyst – Commercial transforms complex Datasets into clear, actionable insights that support decision making across the organization. Working within a Matrix structure and closely aligned with the Commercial function, this person partners with business stakeholders to understand priorities, interpret commercial Data, and deliver high-quality analysis, reporting, dashboards, and presentations.


This person reports to the Business Data Manager, and will collaborate closely with Commercial stakeholders, Business Leaders, Technical Specialists, and Data Governance teams to support performance cycles, improve reporting capabilities, and strengthen data-driven decision making across the business.


The Data Analyst – Commercial will:

  • Partner with Commercial stakeholders to understand business priorities and deliver Data-driven insights that support operational and strategic decision-making;
  • Produce accurate and timely management reporting, analyzing commercial performance and identifying trends, risks, opportunities, and deviations from plan;
  • Support functional performance cycles (including sales pipeline reviews, demand planning, SKU rationalization activities, and sales forecasting);
  • Execute and support Data creation, updates, clean-up, archiving, and deletion activities related to customer Data, pricing, rebates, discounts, commissions, sales areas, and commercial taxonomies;
  • Ensure commercial Data is accurate and consistent across business systems, validating and preparing Datasets in line with Data governance standards;
  • Act as a subject matter expert in SalesForce, providing user support, training, guidance, and continuous improvement recommendations;
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations to improve visibility of commercial performance and decision-making;
  • Prepare and deliver reports, presentations, and commercial insights for sales meetings, customer reviews, and other business reviews;
  • Prepare reports linking SalesForce and Sales Data and support updates of R&D/NBO pipeline information for internal and external communications;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve Data quality, analytical capabilities, reporting processes, and business tools;


A typical day will include analyzing commercial performance, maintaining dashboards, supporting sales and demand planning activities, attending sales meetings, validating Data quality, supporting SalesForce users, and delivering insights that support key business decisions.


Please consider that this role requires availability for occasional travel to other company sites, approximately once per year.


What you will need to succeed


As a Data Analyst – Commercial, you will need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Management, or another analytical or business-related field;
  • +3 years of experience within an International Manufacturing or Industrial environment;
  • +3 years of experience in analytical or support roles within Sales, Commercial, or related business functions;
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports, and Data visualizations that deliver actionable business insights;
  • Experience supporting demand planning, sales performance reviews, pipeline analysis, customer Data management, pricing, and commercial reporting;
  • Advanced Data collection, cleansing, validation, and reporting skills;
  • Experience working within Matrix Organizations and collaborating with Cross-Functional Teams (would be a plus);
  • Advanced Excel skills (including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, advanced functions, and graphs);
  • Experience with project management tools;
  • Knowledge of Python, SQL, and SharePoint management (would be a plus);
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced international environment;
  • Excellent communication skills – Fluency in English.


What the Company can offer you


Have the opportunity to join a cross-functional team in an international company with a multicultural working environment!


Next Steps


If you are interested in this opportunity, please send us your updated CV. If you are looking for another type of professional challenge, please contact us to discuss other career opportunities, always in complete confidence.

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Within the IT department of Natixis BPCESI (BPCE Solutions Informatiques), in Distribution et Data: We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to join our team. Gather and clean data from various sources, including databases, spreadsheets, and external APIs; maintain and update databases to ensure data integrity and accessibility.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Title: Lead Data Consultant
Description:
Company Description

Hitachi Solutions Europe is a global Digital, Data and Technology consultancy, Microsoft Solution Partner and Cloud Services partner, specialising in end-to-end transformation.

As a global consultancy company working across the private and public sectors, we specialise in Dynamics 365 Business Applications, Power Platform, including Azure, Application Modernisation and Data & Analytics.

Our highly skilled team help drive improvements, creating efficiency and growth within organisations. We are committed to Microsoft technologies, with a mission to revolutionise modern businesses.

To achieve this we employ the best, most dedicated talent to deliver outstanding technology solutions to both our local and global clients.




Be part of our Hitachi family

We place value on collaboration, open communication, and transparency. We emphasise the importance of team spirit, cohesion, and appreciation. Through our talented people, innovative culture, and technical and business expertise, we deliver game changing outcomes every day. Our learning culture and flat hierarchy are our recipes for success.




Job Description

We are looking for a Lead Data Consultant to join us on our exciting journey and be part of our Hitachi Solutions family.

This is a unique and challenging opportunity for an experienced Analytics Consultant to join the Data, Analytics & AI practice of Hitachi Solutions Portugal.

In this role you will be providing bespoke and cutting-edge data and advanced analytics solutions, bringing significant commercial advantage to some of Europe’s most recognised companies.

The successful candidate will draw upon their experience with data engineering and business intelligence tools and techniques to advise clients on data and analytics best practices and deliver data and analytics solutions on time and to budget.




The main areas of responsibility are:

Provide expert advisory services to clients on advanced analytics and data engineering best practices, ensuring delivery of scalable and efficient solutions.
Lead teams and projects, supporting all aspects of delivery from requirements gathering to solution design and implementation.
Capture client requirements and lead the development of solution architectures that meet both current and future business needs.
Design and develop bespoke Data Platform, Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics solutions, leveraging the latest cloud technologies.
Lead the design, implementation, and optimisation of enterprise data engineering solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databricks, delivering robust, secure, and scalable data products that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
Build and oversee the development of dynamic, interactive reports and dashboards using Power BI, ensuring clear, actionable insights for clients.
Guide teams in data modelling and transformation efforts, ensuring the development of optimised data architectures, including the design of ETL/ELT pipelines.
Mentor and guide junior team members, sharing knowledge and best practices to support their professional development.
Actively contribute to the development of the team in Portugal, ensuring close ties to the rest of the European team.




Qualifications

We are looking to hire ambitious consulting professionals who combine their technical acumen with a genuine enthusiasm for improving organisations:

10+ years of experience designing and delivering cloud-based Data Engineering, Analytics, and AI solutions, ideally within a consulting or systems integration environment.
Extensive experience in a client-facing role, previously working for a consultancy or systems integrator, with a proven track record of leading teams or projects.
Hands-on experience with modern programming languages such as Python and SQL.
Familiarity with data integration tools like Azure Data Factory and Data platform solutions such as Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks.
Expertise in data visualisation and analytics using Power BI, QlikView or Tableau.
Strong experience in data modelling and transformation, including the design of ETL/ELT processes and data warehousing solutions
Experience or awareness of Big Data and Data Science and/or AI technologies, including the integration of Machine Learning models and/or Generative AI components.
Experience in leading, mentoring, and developing Data & Analytics teams, with a passion for coaching and growing talent.
Demonstrated leadership within the Data Engineering and AI domain, acting as a trusted advisor to clients and internal teams.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and client management skills.




Additional Information

Your Benefits

• Flexible and friendly work environment.

• Hybrid work model.

• Work-life balance.

• Competitive salary.

• Health insurance.

• 25 annual leave days.

• Employee Assistance Programme.

• Pension Plan.

Title: Junior Healthcare Data Analyst
HTML:
Learn About Knok

At knok, we dare to lead and humanise the digital transformation of healthcare. We envision a world where everyone has timely access to quality healthcare through digital technology, creating a more equal society. We genuinely believe in it, and you can recognise it in every person who embraces this mission.

Through a Digital Front Door strategy, knok connects patients, providers and healthcare professionals in one place. Our API-first white-label platform enables a continuous, engaging and personalised healthcare experience for all conditions through a cutting-edge Patient Journey Engine.

With regular clinical practice as our main source of knowledge, we leverage ready-to-use data to improve care automation and increase financial savings. Since 2015, we have enabled more than 2.5 million clinical interactions in over 12 countries. Our platform is scalable and AI-ready, enhancing the power of data-driven care to deliver better outcomes during all stages of life.

Are you ready to join us in revolutionising healthcare and making a tangible impact on people's lives?

About The Role

We are looking for a Junior Healthcare Data Analyst to support our teams in turning complex healthcare data into meaningful insights. You'll be working with datasets from different sources, such as clinical operations, insurance processing, and patient journeys - helping us improve care delivery and decision-making.

If you're passionate about using data to make healthcare more accessible and effective, don't stop here - dive deeper!

As an Junior Healthcare Data Analyst, you will:

  • Collect, clean, and analyse healthcare data from multiple sources (e.g. EHR, patient demographics, operational systems), to extract meaningful insights;
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualisations to communicate key metrics and findings to stakeholders, including clinicians, operational teams and leadership team;
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the organisation, including data science, product management, and clinical operations, to support data-driven decision-making;
  • Perform statistical analysis to support population health management, risk stratification, and clinical outcome optimisation;
  • Contribute to improving data quality by identifying data quality issues and anomalies, and work with relevant stakeholders to address and resolve them

What Makes You a Great Fit For This Journey

  • Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Statistics, Biomedical Sciences, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Health Informatics, or a related field. Master's degree preferred;
  • Experience (academic or professional) with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI or similar;
  • Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining and segmentation techniques;
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear insights that support better decision-making;
  • Knowledge of programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and statistical modeling;
  • Ability to explain a dashboard or an analysis to someone without a technical background, in a simple and practical way;
  • Care when working with data to ensure accuracy, consistency and reliability;
  • Ability to manage several analytical tasks at the same time, prioritising what has the greatest impact on the business and patients

Nice to have:

  • Experience with SQL;
  • Experience with Apache Superset;
  • Previous experience or exposure to the healthcare sector

Recruitment stages

  • People Interview: A conversation to get to know you better, explore your background and motivation, and introduce you to knok, our culture, and the role.
  • Case Study: A practical exercise designed to understand how you approach data, structure your analysis, and turn information into meaningful insights.
  • Final Interview: A conversation with the Hiring Manager where you'll present your case study, explain your reasoning, and discuss your approach in more detail

Title: (Senior) Analytics Solutions Engineer
HTML:
Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist that develops and produces sustainable, safe and convenient solutions for automotive manufacturers as well as industrial and end customers worldwide.

Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 78,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

Job Description

As a (Senior) Analytics Solutions Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of business-critical analytics solutions that support decision-making across Product Management, Sales, and Strategy in EMEA (Strategy, Analytics and Marketing).

This role focuses on the design, development, and continuous enhancement of Power BI applications that translate complex data into actionable insights with measurable business impact.

You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand key challenges and ensure that analytical solutions address real decision-making needs. In parallel, you will act as a central interface to Data Engineering and IT, ensuring that requirements are translated into scalable and sustainable data solutions.

You will own and further develop already existing tools as technical key user with a strong focus on performance, usability, quality and active user management.

Your work will directly influence strategic decisions, uncover growth opportunities, and contribute to tangible business value across the organization.

Your main responsibilities:

  • Own and further develop Power BI applications and dashboard ecosystems;
  • Design analytics solutions that enable business decision-making beyond standard reporting;
  • Gather, translate and formalize business requirements into scalable technical solutions and user stories;
  • Independently acquire, integrate, transform and model data for Power BI solutions from multiple enterprise sources;
  • Build and maintain a consistent single source of truth across business-critical datasets;
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to identify data gaps and enable integration of additional data sources;
  • Work closely with stakeholders across Business, Product, Data Engineering and IT to ensure alignment and adoption;
  • Ensure analytics solutions deliver measurable business value and continuously improve performance, usability and relevance;
  • Support rollout and continuous improvement of analytics products in collaboration with the Product Owner.

Qualifications

  • University degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a comparable field;
  • Multiple years of experience in Power BI development, BI (data modeling, DAX, data integration, performance optimization);
  • Proven track record of delivering analytics solutions with measurable business impact;
  • Experience designing intuitive, user-centric BI applications with a strong focus on UX/UI;
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases;
  • Experience integrating and modeling data from enterprise sources (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Hive, Azure-based platforms; experience with Microsoft Fabric is a plus);
  • Experience collaborating with Data Engineering teams and translating business requirements into technical solutions;
  • Experience working in Agile teams using Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with both business and technical stakeholders;
  • Structured, solution-oriented mindset with strong ownership;
  • Knowledge of automotive, vehicle, tire, or fitment data (is a plus);
  • Proficient English language skills (written and verbal);
  • Willingness to travel occasionally within EMEA.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a builder mindset - someone who does not just analyze data, but actively designs and delivers solutions that create real business impact. Strong business affinity and understanding how decisions are made in real-world, complex environments, translating that understanding into effective analytics products and BI applications.

This role requires a hands-on professional who thrives in the bridge between business and technology, takes full ownership of their work, and continuously improves the solutions they build.

You should be proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working in an Agile environment with cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful, data-driven outcomes.

Additional Information

Our offer:

  • Integration in a challenging and international work environment;
  • Flexible working model;
  • Collaborative working style;
  • Continuous opportunities for personal development and learning.

We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and valued. All kind of applications are welcome.

Contribute to model lifecycle management, including model and provider changes and context window considerations.
Analyse cost and latency trade-offs when selecting and implementing AI solutions.
Collaborate closely with Business Analysts and technical teams to translate business processes and operational knowledge into AI agent behaviour.
Ensure the reliability, scalability and quality of AI solutions in production environments.
Work collaboratively within a multicultural and international team.




Requirements:

3–6 years of experience in Python development.
At least 1–2 years of experience working with LLM/Generative AI applications.
Practical experience with at least one AI agent framework, such as:
CrewAI
LangGraph
LangChain
AutoGen
Similar frameworks
Understanding of ReAct-style agent loops, tool calling and structured outputs.
Strong knowledge of prompt engineering.
Experience with RAG patterns and LLM evaluation techniques.
Experience consuming REST and/or gRPC APIs.

Experience with asynchronous Python.
Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Ability to deploy applications, read logs and safely manage Kubernetes ConfigMaps.
Strong testing culture and experience with pytest.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Strong collaboration and communication skills.
Fluent English.

Title: Senior Software Engineer
Description:
Join us as a Sr. Software Engineer on the R&D Software Team and own real software from the ground up — not a ticket queue. You'll shape the roadmap, make the technical calls, and build the real-time data platform that turns industrial IoT telemetry into decisions our customers can act on.

Where You'll Work: This is a remote-friendly role — most of your work in practice can be done remotely, with occasional in-person collaboration at our Porto office. Our engineers tell us that flexibility is one of the things they value most about working here.

Job Duties and Responsibilities: Reporting to the Digital Integration Director, you will own software solutions end to end, from framing the business problem to running services reliably in production, built on real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors monitoring liquid and gas storage tanks across industries including industrial chemical, industrial gas, propane, and other fuels. Collaborate for success


Own projects end to end, starting from a greenfield state: define your own requirements, shape the roadmap, and take solutions through to production.
Work cross-functionally with teams like Sales and Marketing, translating business goals into working software.
Make the technical decisions and contribute significantly to the implementation — this is a hands-on role, not a hand-off-to-others one.


Build data-driven systems


Build and operate the backend services and APIs behind a platform ingesting real-time telemetry from industrial IoT sensors at sites across the globe.
Design and run the data pipelines that turn that telemetry into something people can act on — including forecasting and anomaly detection on time series.
Work with the realities of sensor data: gaps, drift, irregular sampling, and a device population that keeps evolving. Bring the statistical judgment to tell a real signal from noise, and to say how confident we should be.
Run what you build — instrumentation, alerting, and the operational habits that keep a system healthy.


Engineer with AI assistance


Use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, and similar — as a normal part of daily delivery.
Hold AI-generated code to the same bar as any other code. You are accountable for what you ship.
Structure repositories, tests, and documentation so both people and agents can work in them effectively, and share the patterns and guardrails that work so the team's baseline rises.
Apply Anova's AI Handbook guidance on risk and human-in-the-loop validation to any system whose output reaches a customer or drives an automated action.


Advocate for quality


Contribute to and continuously adapt best practices and Ways of Working across software engineering, data engineering, and platform operations, so the team ships high-quality solutions that create real impact for our clients.


What Success Looks Like


Backend services and data pipelines for real-time IoT telemetry run reliably in production, with strong instrumentation and alerting in place.
Forecasting and anomaly detection outputs are trustworthy enough that customers and internal stakeholders act on them with confidence.
Engineering practices — code review, testing, CI/CD, AI-assisted development — visibly raise the team's baseline, not just this person's own output.
Other engineers are actively mentored and leveled up through code review and design discussion.
Business stakeholders trust this person to translate technical trade-offs and uncertainty into decisions they can act on.


What you'll need to succeed: Minimum Requirements -


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or scientific field — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5+ years in software engineering or a closely related role, including hands-on production deployment (6–8 years preferred). A completed PhD in a quantitative or scientific discipline, with substantial hands-on programming, counts toward this.
Strong Python and the engineering habits that go with it: git, code review, linters, unit tests, and CI/CD pipelines are things you use daily.
Strong analytical ability and working fluency with statistics: distributions, uncertainty, correlation and causation, and knowing when a result is real.
Solid SQL and experience working with data at scale — pandas, PySpark, and platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Postgres.
Experience operating software in production: deployment, monitoring, alerting, and a feel for the practices that make that sustainable.
Fluency with agentic coding tools.
Fluent in written and spoken English.


Preferred Qualifications -


Depth in the Azure Databricks platform: PySpark, streaming pipelines.
Time series work in production: forecasting, anomaly detection, or similar.
Experience with message queuing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
Experience implementing agentic workflows in production — building them, not just calling them.
Hands-on with an agent framework: LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MetaGPT, or similar. We care that you have shipped one, not which one.
Familiarity with the interoperability protocols — MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent2Agent) — for exposing systems as tools other agents can call directly, and for getting agents to talk to each other.
Experience with Microsoft Foundry for building, evaluating, and deploying agents.
Domain experience in industrial, energy, or IoT settings.


About Anova

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.
